$comment: ★★ A LINKED OBJECT'S `/STACK:` SETS THE PROGRAM'S STACK (P69 round 4, D-LK-COFF-READER-SKIPPED-EVERY-LINKER-DIRECTIVE). The archive's one member is cl 19.44's `/c /O2 /MD /GS-` build of `#pragma comment(linker, "/STACK:0x10000000,0x20000") int dss_stack_member_frames(void) { return 4000; }` (its `.drectve`: `/STACK:0x10000000,0x20000 /DEFAULTLIB:MSVCRT /DEFAULTLIB:OLDNAMES`). main.c reads SizeOfStackReserve and SizeOfStackCommit back from its own image (2 or 3 if either is not the directive's) and then recurses about 12 MiB deep, which the default 1 MiB reserve cannot hold. ✔MEASURED 2026-10-07: the same main.c built by cl the same way and linked against this archive runs to 42 under link.exe 14.44 and lld-link 19.1.5 (`.orchestrators/p69/work/xa/r4fix/fix.log`). The `release` arm pins that optimizing the DSS half keeps the recursion: each frame is read after the call returns, so no pass can turn it into a loop.
